items.title: DEMONS
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
These fierce demons are ready for anything. Choose any of these cool demon outfits for your next Minecraft adventure!

+ Demon styled skins
+ Includes 10 demon teen skins with horns
+ Great for role-playing
+ Scary


DEMONS by: Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Rainbows and Unicorns
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: Pugs, rainbows, and unicorns oh my! Cake too? What on earth! This has to be a dream. 14 skins in all, overflowing with fun, magic, and color!

items.title: Among Galaxies 2
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
In space you are always among stars and planets. With these skins you can now dress up in space attire! You and your friends can roleplay as astronauts wearing fashionable clothing.

- 14 astronaut skins

items.title: Cute Teen Style
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Are you ready to make all of your friends jealous with the coolest modern fashion? In our latest skin pack Cute Teen Style, you can make sure that your outfits are the absolute best. With the cutest modern fashion on the Marketplace, you’ll impress everyone with your knowledge of all of the latest fashion trends!

- 12 modern teen skins!
- Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Punk Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Are you looking for the latest punk styles? Find everything from corsets to oversized sweaters in this skin pack! These skins are made for everyone to rock the latest trends! Excellent for roleplay or just hanging with friends.

+ 10 inclusive skins for everyone!
+ Multiple style types
+ Up to date trendy skins for roleplay

items.title: Modern Mob Fashion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Dress up and rule the city with the Modern Mob Fashion pack! Choose from a variety of awesome jobs like an artist, farmer, and even a policeman! Be the coolest kid on the block with these stylish mob skins.

- 12 awesome skins!
- Perfect for role-playing teens
- By isuramuo

items.title: Ender Golf
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Teleport your way through thematic ender golf holes like a city, a castle, and the ender dragon. Play any way you want! Race your friends to the end in speed golf or play the traditional way and take turns. Just watch out for pirates and dinosaurs. 
- Multiplayer
- 12 thematic ender golf holes
- Fight dinosaurs, pirates, mummies, and more
- 5 skins

Is that a dinosaur?

items.title: Element Masters 2
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
The Element Masters have arrived again, dominating different elements, their powers are impressive! Why are you waiting to acquire these amazing skins?

-11 Different Element Masters
-1 Free Element Masters
-by UnderBlocks

items.title: Aesthetic Trend Teens
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Aesthetic Trend Teens has finally arrived in the marketplace, try this skin pack and you will have the ultimate style, are you ready to be the most fashionable among your friends?

+ 11 Aesthetic Trend Teens
+ 1 free skin
-By UnderBlocks Studios

items.title: Techno Nauts 2
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Techno astronauts are back to throw the biggest party in their spaceships! Dance the galaxy away in one of these techno skins! These skins are colorful and are perfect for role-play!

- 15 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Steampunk Teens
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Steampunk Teens has arrived to the marketplace, enjoy your next adventures or inventions being one of these amazing characters.

+11 skins
+1 free skin
-Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Mining Robot Suits
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Ready to dig deep? Pick a robot, suit up and start collecting resources! Sell the items you have collected to the shopkeeper and unlock new mines, new robots and upgrades! Can you manage to unlock everything? Are you a real miner?

+Unique abilities!
+4 futuristic robot suits!
+Custom build mining area!
+Each mine has unique ores!

items.title: Hacker Tools World
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Hacker tools is a base the the most overpowered tools in Minecraft.

+ Open world
+ Hacked tools that you can use in survival or roleplay
+ 1 skin included

items.title: Radiation
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Toxic goo is overflowing the secret lab, mutating and destroying everything in its path. Become one of the cleanup crew or even one of the mutated beings.

items.title: Crazy Patterns
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Why not try modern art as your next skin? Stun and confuse your friends with these wacky designs that will really make them ponder. With 63 designs to choose from there is bound to be one just right for you.

-63 skins

items.title: Mob High School
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
You've seen mobs, and you've seen high schoolers... Why not combine them both? School has never been so mobbed! Whether you're a punk creeper, or a skater zombie, pick your favourite mob and become a Mob High School student!

- 10 skins inside!
- Are you ready for the pep rally!?
- By 57Digital

items.title: CTF at Sequoia Camp
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Team up with your friends and prepare to strategize as you pass, sneak, and race the opposing team’s flag back your cabin for the win! 

- Supports even teams of 1v1 - 5v5 with observers.
- Quick Start feature lets you jump right in by automatically assigning teams and starting a match!
- 14 original skins
- Realm friendly
- Multi-player only

items.title: Anime Fashion
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Upgrade your skin wardrobe with these anime fashionable teens!

items.title: Action Heroes
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Help, help! Save us from catastrophe! Become the action hero you always dreamed of being with the Action Heroes skin pack. Take to the skies and lift the heaviest of ores with these shining, fantastical skins!

- 10 skins included
- Choose your own superpower!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Emoji Masks
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Emojis are a perfect way of expressing yourself, so why not make it better with the new Emojis Masks skin pack? Pick your cutest, most used emoji and run around showing everyone how you feel without having to say it!

- 6 skins included :O :P :S :( :D
- By 57Digital

items.title: Clocks
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Tick, tock, tick, tock... Time is ticking, and what better way to tell than by being a clock yourself? Lucky, you always have the time on you! Analog, digital, grandfather - the choice is yours! You have all the time in the world to choose!

- 6 ticking skins
- No batteries needed
- By 57Digital

items.title: Beach Party Teens
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
It's time for a beach party, enjoying the ultimate tropical vibes!

+ 8 teens preparing to have lots of fun, together!

* By Senior Studios & Blackstone Studios!

items.title: PORTABLE HOUSES!
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
Take your base with you in this new survival experience! Place your house anywhere you want at any time. You can build additional houses to take with you on your travel or customize the houses we provide. 
- Take your house anywhere you want!
- Customize your survival house or use it's storage anywhere you want!
- Make your own portable base!
- 8 save slots!

items.title: Veggie PJs
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Ready to hit the hay? First, grab your favorite jammies, brush those teeth and then dream about your favorite veggie! Come on... everyone has a favorite veggie, right?

- HD skins
- By 57Digital
